name: codex-job-orchestrator
author: awslew
description: Local async MCP orchestrator: dispatch long-running coding jobs from Codex to Claude Code, Codex-native subagents, or DeepSeek Harness workers (start/status/wait/watch/reply/cancel/list/health).

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test "dist-test/test/*.test.js"
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-test-tier.mjs unit
scripts.test:integration:serial: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-test-tier.mjs integration
scripts.test:windows: npm run build:test && node scripts/run-test-tier.mjs windows
scripts.test:gate: npm run build && npm run build:test && node scripts/run-test-tier.mjs gate
